title: Force and attest fmpz backend
objective: Allow an explicit fmpz native-backend override for qualified programs and bind the selected exact backend into authenticated complex-cubic frontier runtime evidence for source-matched GMP/fmpz A/B measurements

oracles: frontier runtime identity and schema validation

handoff.summary: Commit fbaed246 admits SAGEJS_NATIVE_INTEGER_BACKEND=fmpz only for functions whose exact analysis selected the fmpz backend; unqualified and native-unavailable calls fail closed. The frontier runner now accepts --sagejs-integer-backend auto|gmp|fmpz and records requested, selected, and enforcement semantics in a v4 no-inheritance direct-environment identity. That identity includes the exact environment variable and is hashed through runtime closure, census checkpoint keys, warmup attestation, and timing source matching, preventing GMP/fmpz evidence reuse. Focused compiled fmpz/GMP/JavaScript differential, unavailable-backend, unqualified-backend, runner identity, and evidence-gate tests pass.
risks: Forcing fmpz deliberately makes the complex-cubic frontier census decline or fail until the complete closed program is compiler-qualified for fmpz; this is the safety signal needed before timing, not a compatibility fallback.

The evidence JSON schema did not require a change because the authenticated direct-process identity is carried inside the existing source/runtime-closure object; consumers must inspect candidate_runtime_closure.direct_process_environment.exact_integer_backend.

pnpm architecture:check reaches the inherited optimizer-opportunity dashboard and fails because its manifest input digest is stale; all preceding FFI, package, native, Wasm, resource-lifetime, and CoWasm checks pass.

A full pnpm test:native attempt was stopped during its redundant FLINT addon rebuild after the focused compiled suite and an earlier full pnpm build passed; two existing matrix-backed fmpz tests then lacked the interrupted generated direct addon, while tests not requiring that package adapter continued to pass.
next_steps: Integrate this lane before source-matched GMP/fmpz corpus measurements.

After the closed cubic program is fmpz-qualified, run separate agreeing censuses and retained timings with --sagejs-integer-backend gmp and fmpz; their runtime identities and checkpoint keys will be distinct.
Regenerate the shared optimizer-opportunity artifacts in the integration lane after compiler work settles.
